visual_elements.description: Neural network flowchart with three horizontal rows. Left side shows purple input dots labeled 'Input Sample' with arrow. First column: white circles with red Sigma (Σ) connected to f[] boxes, then ellipsis (...). Second column: blue circles with Sigma (Σ), labeled 'Net_j' (red) and 'O_j' (black), connected to f[] boxes. Third column: green circles with Sigma (Σ), labeled 'Net_j' (red) and 'O_j' (black), connected to f[] boxes, then arrows to 'Output 1', 'Output 2', 'Output m'. Yellow circles with 'w_ji' sit above connections to green nodes. Blue 'w_ji' text appears on diagonal connections. Purple circled '1' annotations appear near bottom left and center bottom. Right side: vertical dark red bar labeled 'Error Error' vertically, with light green boxes 'Class 1', 'Class 2', 'Class m' to its right.
visual_elements.position: center, spanning from left edge to right edge of slide content area

visual_elements.description: Bottom-left box titled 'For Layer "j"' containing two equations: Net_j = Σ (w_ji * O_i) and O_j = f(Net_j) = 1 / (1 + e^-Net_j)
Box titled 'Previous Layer Layer (0)' with an upward arrow (↑) above it
Box titled 'Current Layer is Output Layer (You are here)' with an upward arrow (↑) above it
Box titled 'If Layer "j" is Output Layer:' containing equation E = 1/2 Σ (t_j - O_j)^2
Vertical dark red rectangular bar labeled 'Error Error' in white vertical text, positioned between output nodes and class labels
